# has privacy notice

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasPrivacyNotice`](gmeow-hasPrivacyNotice.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasPrivacyNotice>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)

Relates an entity or rights statement to its privacy notice. Domain-free: a notice may be attached to a [`RightsStatement`](../classes/gmeow-RightsStatement.md), a Licence, or directly to the governed entity.

**Property shape:** object property; `?` -> [`gmeow:PrivacyNotice`](../classes/gmeow-PrivacyNotice.md)
